required_topics: human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
identifying individuals most at risk for human trafficking
differences between labor and sex trafficking in the context of lodging establishments, restaurants, and truck stops
roles of employees in reporting and responding to instances of human trafficking
law_references: Strengthening Human Trafficking Protections in Lodging Establishments, Restaurants, and Truck Stops (SB1422)
notes: Training must be completed within 6 months of employment and every 2 years thereafter.
Employers may use their own program or a third-party program that includes specified topics.
